Authentication ​

Every method throws SkapiError with .code and .message. Methods that need a signed-in user throw INVALID_REQUEST (User login is required.) without one, and any method can throw NETWORK_ERROR when no answer comes back.

Values that fail a check throw INVALID_PARAMETER before anything is sent. The common messages:

fieldmessage
email"email" is required. / "email" should be at least 5 characters. / "<value>" is an invalid email.
password"password" is required. / "password" should be at least 6 characters. / "password" can be up to 60 characters max.
phone_number"phone_number" is invalid. The format should be "+00123456789". Type: string.
birthdate"birthdate" is invalid. The format should be "yyyy-mm-dd". Type: string.
picture, profile, website, redirect URLs"<value>" is an invalid url. (a full URL with scheme and host is required)
text fields<value> is invalid in "<field>". allowed type or value is: Type<string>.

signup ​

swift
func signup(_ params: JSON, option: JSON? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Creates an account. Logs out the user signed in on this object first.

params:

keytype
emailstringrequired
passwordstringrequired, 6 to 60 characters
usernamestringoptional permanent login ID; the e-mail logs in too once verified
name, nickname, given_name, middle_name, family_name, gender, miscstring
birthdatestring"yyyy-mm-dd"
phone_numberstring"+" and digits
addressstring or object
picture, profile, websitestringfull URL
email_public, phone_number_public, address_public, gender_public, birthdate_publicbooldefault false

option:

keytype
signup_confirmationbool or stringtrue sends a confirmation link the user must open before logging in. A full URL also does, and the link leads there after confirming. Default false.
loginboollog in right after signup and return the profile. Not with signup_confirmation.
email_subscriptionbool, number or stringsubscribes the user to a newsletter once they confirm. Needs signup_confirmation.
templateobject["signup_confirmation": "<message_id>", "welcome": "<message_id>"]: uploaded templates for this call

Returns a JSON string, "SUCCESS: The account has been created." or "SUCCESS: The account has been created. User's signup confirmation is required." with signup_confirmation, or the profile object with login. See Signing Up Users.

Errors ​

codemessage
EXISTSThe account already exists.
INVALID_PARAMETERKey "email" is required. / Key "password" is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"address" should be type: <string | dict>.
INVALID_PARAMETERInvalid password. Password must be at least 6 characters.
INVALID_PARAMETER"option.signup_confirmation" should be type: <string | boolean>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"login" is not allowed when "option.signup_confirmation" is true. / "option.login" should be type: boolean.
INVALID_PARAMETER"option.signup_confirmation" should be true if "email_public" is set to true.
INVALID_PARAMETER"option.signup_confirmation" is required for email subscription.
INVALID_PARAMETER"option.signup_confirmation" is required when "option.template.signup_confirmation" is set.
INVALID_PARAMETER"option.template" should be type: <object>. / "option.template.<key>" should be a non-empty <string> (template message_id).
REQUEST_EXCEEDToo many attempts. Please try again later.
CODE_DELIVERY_FAILUREFailed to deliver verification code.
INVALID_REQUESTthe server's reason

resendSignupConfirmation ​

swift
func resendSignupConfirmation() async throws -> JSON

Sends the signup confirmation e-mail again. Works after login threw SIGNUP_CONFIRMATION_NEEDED, or after signup with signup_confirmation, on the same object. Returns the server's message.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTLeast one login attempt is required.

login ​

swift
func login(email: String? = nil, username: String? = nil, password: String) async throws -> JSON

Signs in and returns the profile. The e-mail is matched without regard to case. An email that is not an e-mail address is read as a username. The password is never sent: sign-in proves it with a secure exchange. The session is saved to storage. See Login / Logout.

Errors ​

codemessage
INCORRECT_USERNAME_OR_PASSWORDIncorrect username or password.
SIGNUP_CONFIRMATION_NEEDEDUser's signup confirmation is required.
USER_IS_DISABLEDThis account is disabled.
MFA_REQUIREDA code from the authenticator app is required to sign in. Call verifyMFA() with the code.
REQUEST_EXCEEDToo many attempts. Please try again later.
INVALID_PARAMETERAt least one of "username" or "email" is required.
INVALID_REQUESTSign-in codes by SMS are not supported. / The account must set up an authenticator app before signing in.

verifyMFA ​

swift
func verifyMFA(code: String) async throws -> JSON

Finishes a login or openIdLogin that threw MFA_REQUIRED, with the 6 digit code from the authenticator app (spaces are ignored). Call it on the same object within 3 minutes. Returns the profile. See Two-Step Login.

codemessage
INVALID_CODEIncorrect authenticator code. / This authenticator code was already used. Wait for the next code. (retry with the next code)
INVALID_REQUESTNo sign-in is waiting for an authenticator code. Call login() first.
INVALID_REQUESTThe sign-in has expired. Call login() again.
INVALID_PARAMETER"code" should be the 6 digit code from the authenticator app.
REQUEST_EXCEEDToo many attempts. Please try again later.

logout ​

swift
func logout(global: Bool = false) async throws -> String

Signs out and removes the session from storage. global: true also ends every session of the account on every device. On an anonymous account it deletes the account. With encryption on, the key this device remembers is removed. Returns "SUCCESS: The user has been logged out."

getProfile ​

swift
func getProfile(refreshToken: Bool = false) async -> JSON?

The signed-in user's profile, or nil. refreshToken: true gets fresh tokens from the server first and returns nil if that fails. It does not throw.

user ​

swift
var user: JSON? { get async }
var session: SkapiSession? { get async }

await skapi.user is the signed-in user's profile (a copy), or nil. The first read restores a session saved in storage.

await skapi.session holds the tokens:

property
idToken.jwtTokenthe ID token
accessToken.jwtTokenthe access token
refreshTokenthe refresh token

Each JwtToken also has payload (the token's claims, a JSONObject), expiration and issuedAt (seconds).

loginWithToken ​

swift
func loginWithToken(idToken: String, accessToken: String, refreshToken: String) async throws -> JSON

Takes over the tokens of a sign-in made elsewhere and returns the profile read from the ID token. All three tokens are required; the object is then signed in as that user and the tokens are saved to storage. The token's signature is not checked locally; the server checks it on each request.

codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"idToken" is required. / "accessToken" is required. / "refreshToken" is required.
INVALID_REQUESTToken does not belong to this service. / Token has expired.

updateProfile ​

swift
func updateProfile(_ params: JSON) async throws -> JSON

Changes the signed-in user's own profile and returns the updated profile. Takes the same profile keys as signup except password and username. "" clears a field (not email). The *_public flags must be bools. Other keys are ignored; with nothing to change, it returns the profile without a request. A changed email becomes unverified. See User Profile.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot edit their profile.
INVALID_REQUESTUser's e-mail should be verified to set "email_public" to true.
INVALID_PARAMETER<value> is invalid in "<flag>". allowed type or value is: Type<boolean>.
the server's codethe server's message, when it refuses the change

changePassword ​

swift
func changePassword(currentPassword: String, newPassword: String) async throws -> String

Returns "SUCCESS: Password has been changed." With encryption on, the keyring gets a wrap under the new password first. See Passwords.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTIncorrect password.
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot change their password.
INVALID_PARAMETER"current_password" is required to change password. / "new_password" is required to change password.
INVALID_PARAMETER"new_password" should be at least 6 characters. / "new_password" can be up to 60 characters max. (the same for current_password)
INVALID_PARAMETERInvalid password parameter.
REQUEST_EXCEEDToo many attempts. Please try again later.
ENCRYPTION_LOCKEDencryption is on and locked; the password is not changed

forgotPassword ​

swift
func forgotPassword(email: String, template: JSON? = nil) async throws -> String

E-mails a password reset code. template: ["forgot_password": "<message_id>"] uses an uploaded template for this call. Returns "SUCCESS: Verification code has been sent."

codemessage
NOT_EXISTSthe server's message
INVALID_REQUESTthe server's message, for example User password cannot be reset in the current state.
REQUEST_EXCEEDthe server's message, for example Attempt limit exceeded, please try after some time.
CODE_DELIVERY_FAILUREthe server's message
INVALID_PARAMETER"template" should be type: <object>. / "template.forgot_password" should be a non-empty <string> (template message_id).

resetPassword ​

swift
func resetPassword(email: String, code: String, newPassword: String) async throws -> String

Sets a new password with the code from forgotPassword. Returns "SUCCESS: New password has been set." A wrong or expired code throws the server's code and message, for example CodeMismatchException.

verifyEmail ​

swift
func verifyEmail(code: String? = nil, template: JSON? = nil) async throws -> String

Without code, e-mails a verification code and returns "SUCCESS: Verification code has been sent." With code, verifies the e-mail and returns SUCCESS: "email" is verified., which is also returned at once when the e-mail is already verified. template: ["verification": "<message_id>"] uses an uploaded template for the code e-mail. See E-Mail Verification.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTThe user has to be logged in. / No e-mail to verify
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot verify an e-mail.
INVALID_PARAMETER"template.verification" should be a non-empty <string> (template message_id).
CodeMismatchExceptionInvalid verification code provided, please try again.
LimitExceededExceptionAttempt limit exceeded, please try after some time.

lastVerifiedEmail ​

swift
func lastVerifiedEmail(revert: Bool? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Returns the user's last verified e-mail as a JSON string (the current one, if it is verified). revert: true switches the account back to that e-mail, verified, and returns the updated profile.

codemessage
NOT_EXISTSUser does not have a verified e-mail.
EXISTSE-mail "<email>" is already a login ID in this project.
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot change their e-mail.

disableAccount ​

swift
func disableAccount() async throws -> JSON

Disables the signed-in user's account and logs out. The account's data is deleted after 90 days unless it is recovered. Returns the server's message, "SUCCESS: account has been disabled."

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous accounts cannot be disabled.

recoverAccount ​

swift
func recoverAccount(redirect: JSON = false) async throws -> String

After login threw USER_IS_DISABLED on this object, e-mails a recovery link to the account. redirect is false, true, or a full URL string, where the link leads after the recovery: recoverAccount(redirect: "https://your.site/welcome-back"). Returns "SUCCESS: Recovery e-mail has been sent."

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTLeast one signin attempt of disabled account is required.
INVALID_REQUESTArgument should be type: <boolean | string>.

openIdLogin ​

swift
func openIdLogin(token: String, id: String, merge: JSON? = nil, template: JSON? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Signs in through the OpenID logger id with a token from the provider, creating the account on first use. merge: true merges into an existing account with the same login ID; an array of attribute names (or one name) also copies those OpenID attributes. template: ["welcome": "<message_id>"] uses an uploaded template for the welcome e-mail.

Returns {"userProfile": profile, "openid": provider attributes}. Can throw MFA_REQUIRED, USER_IS_DISABLED and REQUEST_EXCEED like login. See OpenID Login.

codemessage
ACCOUNT_EXISTSThe account already exists. (retry with merge)
INVALID_REQUESTThe account needs to be confirmed.
EXISTSThe login ID of this OpenID account is already used by another account.
INVALID_PARAMETER"merge" should be type: <boolean | string[]>. / "merge" array items should be type: <string>.
INVALID_PARAMETER"template" should be type: <object>. / "template.welcome" should be a non-empty <string> (template message_id).

anonymousLogin ​

swift
func anonymousLogin() async throws -> JSON

Signs in with a temporary account (anonymous: true, access group 1) and returns its profile. Returns the current account when this object already holds an anonymous session. Sends a keep-alive every 10 minutes while the object lives; the account is deleted 30 minutes after the last one, or at once on logout. See Anonymous Login.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTAnonymous login is not enabled for this project.
INVALID_REQUESTUser limit exceeded.
INVALID_REQUESTA user is already logged in. Log out first.

verifyAnonymousSession ​

swift
func verifyAnonymousSession() async throws -> JSON?

For a temporary account restored from storage: asks the server whether it still exists. Returns the profile, or nil (after signing out) when the account was deleted. Any other signed-in user is returned as is, without a request; signed out returns nil.

setupMFA ​

swift
func setupMFA(issuer: String? = nil, accountName: String? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Starts two-step login setup. Returns {"secret": String, "uri": String}: show uri (otpauth://...) as a QR code, or secret for typing in. issuer defaults to the project name, accountName to the user's e-mail. Follow with enableMFA.

enableMFA ​

swift
func enableMFA(code: String) async throws -> String

Checks a code from the app and turns two-step login on. Returns "SUCCESS: MFA has been enabled."

codemessage
INVALID_CODEIncorrect authenticator code. (nothing changed)
INVALID_REQUESTCall setupMFA() first.
INVALID_PARAMETER"code" should be the 6 digit code from the authenticator app.
REQUEST_EXCEEDToo many attempts. Please try again later.

disableMFA ​

swift
func disableMFA() async throws -> String

Turns two-step login off. Returns "SUCCESS: MFA has been disabled."

getMFAStatus ​

swift
func getMFAStatus() async throws -> JSON

Returns {"enabled": Bool}.

setupMFA, enableMFA, disableMFA and getMFAStatus need a signed-in user and throw INVALID_REQUEST with a message starting with Anonymous accounts cannot on an anonymous account.
